newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CFM Technologies starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CFM Technologies starts.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said analyst Mark FitzGerald had started coverage of CFM Technologies Inc, a vendor of wet processing equipment to the semiconductor and flat panel display industries, with a rating of buy.

-- "We think that the growing acceptance of its technology among semiconductor manufacturers, the impending shift to 300mm wafers and early adoption by flat panel manufacturers can keep revenues growing well above industry averages," FitzGerald wrote in a Feb 18 report.
-- He set a six-to-12-month price target of $45.
-- The company's shares opened unchanged at 36-3/4.
